🟡 **Medium** `docs/eduplus-lagom-design-strategy.html:117` The typography rows overflow horizontally on 320px viewports because the fixed 200px specification column plus the 24px gap leaves only 32px for the example, while `.type-row` cannot wrap or stack its children. Allow the row to wrap so examples move below the specification on narrow screens. ```diff - .type-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:24px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)} + .type-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:24px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline)} ```

Allow the row to wrap so examples move below the specification on narrow screens. ```

🟡 **Medium** `docs/eduplus-lagom-design-strategy.html:93` `.tag.keep` and `.tag.retire` render 10.5px text at only about `3.87:1` and `4.12:1` contrast, respectively, so their labels fail the document's WCAG contrast gate and are difficult to read. Use a darker text token such as `--ink` for these small labels while retaining the colored backgrounds. ```suggestion .tag.keep{background:var(--moss-soft);color:var(--ink)} .tag.evolve{background:var(--ochre-soft);color:var(--ochre-deep)} .tag.retire{background:var(--clay-soft);color:var(--ink)} ```

Use a darker text token such as `--ink` for these small labels while retaining the colored backgrounds. ```

🟡 **Medium** `docs/eduplus-lagom-design-strategy.html:98` At a 320px viewport, the five-column success-criteria table expands beyond the page, so users must scroll the entire document horizontally and the strategy becomes unreadable on phones. The global `table` rule leaves auto layout enabled without a mobile overflow or reflow treatment; make tables horizontally scrollable on small screens while preserving their intrinsic column widths. ```diff - table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;margin:18px 0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden} + table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;margin:18px 0;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--hairline);border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden} + @media(max-width:600px){table{display:block;overflow-x:auto}table>tbody{display:table;min-width:max-content}} ```
🚀 Reply "fix it for me" or copy this AI Prompt for your agent: ```text In file @app/docs/eduplus-lagom-design-strategy.html around line 98: At a 320px viewport, the five-column success-criteria table expands beyond the page, so users must scroll the entire document horizontally and the strategy becomes unreadable on phones. The global `table` rule leaves auto layout enabled without a mobile overflow or reflow treatment; make tables horizontally scrollable on small screens while preserving their intrinsic column widths. ```

The button's `onClick={handleEnrollClick}` invokes `enrollTrack(track.id)` for unenrolled tracks; remove this enrollment handler from the card and leave enrollment to the explicit start/enroll action on the detail page.
